BiblicalUsage: Ir was a son of Benjamin, named in the genealogy of the tribes. In 1 Chronicles 7:12 Shuppim and Huppim are named, and the sons of Ir, in the families of Benjamin that came out of Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ir's one verse is the whole of his record: a son of Benjamin, named among the families, and counted in the tribe.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
